name: watch-party
description: Watch Party - Plataforma para ver videos en sincronía en tiempo real

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
